decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with a dedicated page; it needs few resources and complements the core trailer business, so there is no pressure to withdraw it.
Featured on the home page as a new box trailer series, it is a visible commitment at the core of the firm's announced direction, so management will persist after only one year.
The car transporter required substantial development and tooling investment, and any weak early sales can be attributed to the normal ramp-up period.
This low-bed series is publicly showcased on the home page and central to the product range, so sunk costs and the public commitment favor keeping it.
The high-cover series is prominently shown and closely linked to the core trailer range, which supports continuing it.
A second box trailer series overlaps with B, but its home page visibility and recent investment make dropping it within the first year unlikely.
